# bio-ege.sdamgia.ru

> A comprehensive Russian biology exam preparation platform offering practice problems, solutions, and training materials for the EGE (Unified State Exam).

Part of the РЕШУ ЕГЭ (SDAMGIA) network, bio-ege.sdamgia.ru provides targeted biology problem sets and detailed solutions to help Russian students prepare for the standardized EGE exam. The platform integrates with broader educational resources including OGE, VPR, and CT test preparation systems.

## Key Topics

- ЕГЭ (Unified State Exam)
- Biology
- Problem Solutions
- Exam Preparation
- Test Training
- РЕШУ ЕГЭ
- СДАМ ГИА
- Russian Education
- Practice Problems
- Answer Keys

## Biology Practice Problems

- [ЕГЭ–2026, биология: задания, ответы, решения](https://bio-ege.sdamgia.ru/problem?id=16299): Biology problem #16299 with complete solutions for EGE 2026 exam preparation
